what_extracts_establish: An agent's declaration within authority binds the principal. A messenger conveys the principal's own decision. Authority can be granted by mandate.
what_is_not_established: Whether a provider must accept a cancellation conveyed by a company messenger or agent, and what proof of authority suffices.
conservative_design_implication: Model the service as a messenger conveying the user's own final decision, with a signed, timestamped instruction kept as evidence. No discretion on the user's behalf.
counsel_question: Is a cancellation notice conveyed by a company acting as 使者 (or as 代理人 under a written 委任) effective against a provider without the provider's consent? What form of authority (written, electronic, identity-verified) is needed?

topic: Provider terms restricting who may act
instrument_or_source: docomo proxy rules; かんぽ生命 agent procedure; Netflix household; U-NEXT ID terms
what_extracts_establish: docomo: proxies for individual contracts are family-only (unverified extract). かんぽ: agent's relationship plus a possible call to the policyholder. Netflix: household-only use. U-NEXT: no third-party use of IDs.
what_is_not_established: Whether 'holder-only' or 'family-only' rules are enforceable against a consumer's chosen agent, including under Consumer Contract Act Art. 10 (unfair terms), and how the planned obstruction ban treats refusal of a duly authorised agent.
conservative_design_implication: Assume providers may refuse company agents. Design for family-assisted or user-performed actions (B), with the company preparing, timing and tracking.
counsel_question: Can a provider lawfully refuse a cancellation from a consumer's written-authorised company agent? Would such a refusal be 'refusing a cancellation' under the proposed Consumer Contract Act amendment?

topic: Attorney Act Art. 72: conveying vs negotiating
instrument_or_source: 弁護士法72条; 退職代行 commentary; Supreme Court 1971-07-14 and 1963-06-13 (via doctrine)
what_extracts_establish: Commentary: conveying a person's own decision is lawful for a non-lawyer; negotiating terms is not. The 事件性 requirement is contested. Contracts breaching Art. 72 are void.
what_is_not_established: Whether a routine, undisputed subscription cancellation by a paid company is a 'legal matter'. Whether handling retention offers, fee explanations or effective-date disagreements crosses into negotiation.
conservative_design_implication: Conveyance only. No negotiation of fees, dates, refunds or retention terms. Stop and return control to the user at any disagreement.
counsel_question: For a paid service that conveys a consumer's undisputed cancellation decision, where exactly is the Art. 72 line, and which scripts or behaviours (e.g. answering retention offers, confirming effective dates) cross it?

topic: Official reasoning on Art. 72 for tech services
what_extracts_establish: Three cumulative elements: remuneration, 事件性, and legal affairs requiring expertise. Undisputed ordinary contracts are treated as lacking 事件性 in that context.
what_is_not_established: Whether this reasoning extends to services that act toward a counterparty.
conservative_design_implication: Do not rely on the MOJ guidance as authorisation. Cite it only as context in the counsel brief.
counsel_question: Does the 2023 MOJ 事件性 reasoning carry over to an agent that sends undisputed cancellation notices to providers?

instrument_or_source: 弁護士法 (non-lawyer tie-ups); the モームリ case (2025-26)
what_extracts_establish: A resignation-agency operator was searched (2025-10) and its former head indicted (2026-02-24) in connection with paid lawyer referrals.
what_is_not_established: Outcome of the case. Which referral structures are safe.
conservative_design_implication: Never receive fees for referring disputes. Send J6 cases to free public channels (188) or unpaid lawyer listings.
counsel_question: What dispute-escalation design (if any) is permissible for a non-lawyer cancellation service, and how must any lawyer partnership be structured?

instrument_or_source: 弁護士法72条 (analogy); 電気通信事業法 27-3 fee caps
what_extracts_establish: Negotiation is the side of the resignation-agency line that commentary treats as unlawful for non-lawyers. Telecom exit fees are already capped (¥1,000 mobile; about one month's fee for fixed lines).
what_is_not_established: Whether commercial price negotiation with a telco or ISP, without any dispute, has 事件性. The size of retention discounts in Japan.
conservative_design_implication: Treat C06 as legally high-risk and economically small in Japan until counsel and data say otherwise.
counsel_question: Is negotiating a lower recurring price with a telco or ISP on a consumer's behalf, for a success fee, a 'legal matter' under Art. 72?

topic: Cancellation fees (Consumer Contract Act Art. 9; 2023 amendment)
what_extracts_establish: Charges above 'average damages' are void. Businesses have an effort duty to explain the basis of fees.
what_is_not_established: How often subscription fees in the route sample exceed average damages.
conservative_design_implication: Show the fee and its stated basis before acting (informed consent). Never contest a fee. That is J6, so refer out.
counsel_question: Can the service tell users that a fee 'may be contestable' without giving legal advice?

topic: Planned obstruction ban (Consumer Contract Act reform)
instrument_or_source: CAA expert committee interim summary (2026-08/09); review meetings 2026-07
what_extracts_establish: Proposed: ban misrepresentation, refusal, unreasonable delay and deception or intimidation in cancellations; injunctions by qualified consumer organisations; effort duties on methods, disclosure and renewal notices. Bill as early as the next ordinary Diet session.
what_is_not_established: Final text and timing. Whether phone-only or complex flows are covered. Whether refusing an agent counts as refusal.
conservative_design_implication: Plan for the hard-route friction to shrink from about 2027-28 among compliant providers. Do not build a business whose only value is obstruction.
counsel_question: On the current drafts, which of the E-class route behaviours (phone-only, in person, written) would be unlawful after reform?

topic: 定期購入 rules (Specified Commercial Transactions Act, 2022)
instrument_or_source: 特商法 12条の6; anti-obstruction misrepresentation ban
what_extracts_establish: Final-confirmation display duties; ban on misleading displays; ban on misrepresentation to obstruct cancellation.
what_is_not_established: Whether a non-lawyer service may help consumers invoke statutory rescission.
conservative_design_implication: Help users cancel within the seller's stated process. Invoking statutory rescission is legal action, so refer to 188.
counsel_question: Can a non-lawyer service send a seller a consumer's cancellation that cites the seller's statutory duties, without negotiating?

what_extracts_establish: Mobile: 2-year maximum term and ¥1,000 fee cap. Fixed: fee capped at about one month's charge.
what_is_not_established: Legacy-contract share.
conservative_design_implication: Small money at stake per telco exit. Value lies in convenience, not savings.
counsel_question: n/a (factual)

what_extracts_establish: Purpose specification and notice; no out-of-purpose use or third-party provision without consent (exceptions apply); security measures.
what_is_not_established: Rules for credential custody, call recordings, sharing outcomes with providers, and pseudonymised or anonymised reuse for an outcome graph (M1).
conservative_design_implication: Specify 'improving cancellation routes' as a purpose at collection. Store no provider credentials. Keep outcome records at route level (provider × rail × result), not person level.
counsel_question: Can route-level outcome data derived from user cases be retained and used to improve service for other users, and in what processed form?

instrument_or_source: 銀行法 (電子決済等代行業, 2018)
what_extracts_establish: Registration and bank contracts are required for account-information services. Bank reference APIs are widely available.
what_is_not_established: Cost and time of registration for a startup. Partner terms (Moneytree/MUFG, Money Forward).
conservative_design_implication: No bank linkage in any first test. Later, only via a registered partner, accepting dependence on a competitor-owned pipe.
counsel_question: Is verification-only access (did charge X recur?) subject to the same registration as full account aggregation?

what_extracts_establish: Major card data links mostly rely on screen-scraping, and no standard card API exists.
what_is_not_established: Whether any registration applies to card-data aggregation. Card companies' terms on scraping.
conservative_design_implication: Avoid card-credential custody. Use user-uploaded statements or screenshots in tests.
counsel_question: What legal and contractual exposure does storing card-site credentials for scraping create?

instrument_or_source: Google API user-data policy (restricted scopes; CASA)
what_extracts_establish: gmail.readonly is restricted. Server-side processing needs an annual CASA Tier 2 assessment (about $500 a year per a secondary source).
what_is_not_established: Outlook and Yahoo! Mail rules. Japanese template coverage.
conservative_design_implication: Not for a first test. Use user-forwarded receipts instead.
counsel_question: n/a (platform policy)

what_extracts_establish: Apple: only the user or Apple support can cancel. Google: the developer can cancel via API. No third-party path.
what_is_not_established: Apple's own documentation.
conservative_design_implication: Guide only. The user cancels in Settings or Play.
counsel_question: n/a

topic: Credential use by a third party
instrument_or_source: Netflix household terms; U-NEXT ID terms
what_extracts_establish: Account use is restricted to the household or member. Third-party ID use is prohibited (U-NEXT).
what_is_not_established: Whether a one-off cancellation login by an agent breaches these terms or is tolerated.
conservative_design_implication: No credential-based execution. The user logs in (B). Any automation runs in the user's own session under their control.
counsel_question: Does a user-supervised agent acting in the user's own logged-in session count as third-party use under typical Japanese ID terms?

what_extracts_establish: The new electricity retailer cancels the old contract on the customer's consent. MNP one-stop needs the user's consent in the old carrier's portal.
what_is_not_established: Whether a non-supplier intermediary can trigger these processes.
conservative_design_implication: Per the extracts, on-behalf cancellation is established practice when the gaining provider performs it. A C08 design would therefore run through the gaining provider.
counsel_question: n/a

topic: US limited power of attorney model
what_extracts_establish: Rocket Money users grant a limited POA plus debit/credit authority (US).
what_is_not_established: Any Japanese equivalent's effectiveness or provider acceptance.
conservative_design_implication: Do not copy US terms. Draft from Japanese counsel's answer to L01-L03.
counsel_question: Is a standing (not per-cancellation) authorisation in app terms effective for Japanese cancellations?

what_extracts_establish: Cancelling a deceased person's subscription may count as a dispositive act implying acceptance of the inheritance (a risk to renunciation).
what_is_not_established: Prevalence. Provider bereavement procedures.
conservative_design_implication: Exclude P4 from the first test. It sits close to legal advice.
counsel_question: Can a non-lawyer service help heirs identify (not cancel) a deceased person's subscriptions without legal-advice exposure?

what_extracts_establish: Nothing (no source).
what_is_not_established: When a family member may cancel for an elderly parent without guardianship (成年後見); provider practice.
conservative_design_implication: P3 tests use the adult child as the user acting on their own or the parent's explicit written instruction, never on presumed authority.
counsel_question: What authority does an adult child need to cancel a capable parent's subscriptions, and what changes if capacity is in doubt?

what_extracts_establish: No specific licence regime for a consumer cancellation agent was found.
what_is_not_established: Whether any licence applies; no path found ≠ none required.
conservative_design_implication: Treat as unknown; part of E5.
counsel_question: Does any registration or licence regime apply to a paid consumer cancellation-messenger service?

instrument_or_source: FTC DoNotPay order (US analogy); 景品表示法 not researched
what_extracts_establish: The US regulator penalised unsupported 'robot lawyer' claims (2025-01).
what_is_not_established: Japanese advertising-law exposure.
conservative_design_implication: No 'AI lawyer' or 'cancels anything' claims. State success rates only from measured data.
counsel_question: Which claims about cancellation success and AI capability are permissible under Japanese advertising law?
